description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Burst of Energy without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Burst of Energy, targeting Lotus Field.
Resolve both Burst of Energies, untapping Isochron Scepter and Lotus Field.
Repeat.
